data.name: Mariam
data.gender_notes: Mariam is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Variant of Maryam, the Arabic form of the Hebrew Miriam. Its root is م-ر-ي-م. The mother of Jesus (ʿĪsā). Mariam is a Arabic name meaning “Beloved; exalted; (also) bitter”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mariam expresses “Beloved; exalted; (also) bitter”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Variant of Maryam, the Arabic form of the Hebrew Miriam.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mariam total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
